verses.1:
Hallelujah! + 147:1 Or Hallelu YAH , meaning Praise the LORD ; also in verse 20 
 How good it is to sing praises to our God,
 how pleasant and lovely to praise Him!
verses.2:
The LORD builds up Jerusalem;
 He gathers the exiles of Israel.
verses.3:
He heals the brokenhearted
 and binds up their wounds.
verses.4:
He determines the number of the stars;
 He calls them each by name.
verses.5:
Great is our Lord, and mighty in power;
 His understanding has no limit.
verses.6:
The LORD sustains the humble,
 but casts the wicked to the ground.
verses.7:
Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving;
 make music on the harp to our God,
verses.8:
who covers the sky with clouds,
 who prepares rain for the earth,
 who makes grass to grow on the hills.
verses.9:
He provides food for the animals,
 and for the young ravens when they call.
verses.10:
He does not delight in the strength of the horse;
 He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
verses.11:
The LORD is pleased with those who fear Him,
 who hope in His loving devotion.
verses.12:
Exalt the LORD, O Jerusalem;
 praise your God, O Zion!
verses.13:
For He strengthens the bars of your gates
 and blesses the children within you.
verses.14:
He makes peace at your borders;
 He fills you with the finest wheat.
verses.15:
He sends forth His command to the earth;
 His word runs swiftly.
verses.16:
He spreads the snow like wool;
 He scatters the frost like ashes;
verses.17:
He casts forth His hail like pebbles. + 147:17 Or like crumbs or like morsels 
 Who can withstand His icy blast?
verses.18:
He sends forth His word and melts them;
 He unleashes His winds, and the waters flow.
verses.19:
He declares His word to Jacob,
 His statutes and judgments to Israel.

metadata.source: Derived from the Berean Standard Bible (BSB). Missing verses restored from the Textus Receptus tradition for completeness.
